test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the greatest number by which when the numbers 176 and 273 are divided, it leaves remainders 5 and 3, respectively.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the **remainders** from the **respective numbers**.

176 − 5 = 171

273 − 3 = 270

Find the **HCF** of 171 and 270.

171 = 9 × 19 and 270 = 9 × 30.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 176 and 273

Remainders: 5 and 3

**Formula Used:**

Required number = **HCF** of (Number₁ − Remainder₁) and (Number₂ − Remainder₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6576524445d9b2f913e52f23d1d2c97e470642f6ac84c57530dff847f21974a7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First number = 176 − 5 = 171

⇒ Second number = 273 − 3 = 270

⇒ Prime factorization of 171 = 3 × 3 × 19 = 3² × 19

⇒ Prime factorization of 270 = 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 5 = 2 × 3³ × 5

⇒ HCF (171, 270) = 3² = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

HCF is the **greatest divisor** that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder.

HCF with same remainder

To find the greatest number that leaves the **same remainder** 'r' in each case, calculate HCF(x − r, y − r, z − r).

HCF with unknown same remainder

If the remainder is not given but is same, find the HCF of the **differences** between the numbers: HCF(|x−y|, |y−z|, |z−x|).</p
